senses.gloss: (b. h.; √בק , v. בקא; corresp. to ch. בעי); Pi. בִּיקֵּשׁ, בִּקֵּשׁ to seek, desire, beg, ask.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 65a:14">Kidd. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>מְבַקְּשִׁין וכ׳</he> the court begs him to give her a letter of divorce, opp. to <he>כופין</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12b:14">Ber. 12ᵇ</cite> <he>בִּקְּשׁוּ לקבוע וכ׳</he> they (the Rabbis) intended to insert the chapter about Balak &c.
Gen. R. s. 84 ב׳ לישב וכ׳ he intended to live in peace; a. fr.—ב׳ רחמים to pray (for mercy), v. בעי. Ber. l. c.

senses.gloss: , Nithpa. נִתְבַּקֵּשׁ to be sought, to be hunted for (by detectives); to be summoned.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 29a:14">Taan. 29ᵃ</cite> (a disguised warning given to R. Gamliel) <he>בעל החוטם מִתְבַּקֵּשׁ</he> the well-known man is wanted; v. <cite ref="H00301"><he>חוֹטֶם</he></cite>.
